summary.text: John Blanton is a Republican state representative who has represented District 92 since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: John Blanton was born in Salyersville, Kentucky, and earned a degree from Morehead State University.
His career experience includes working as a major with the Kentucky State Police, and he has been a member of the Magoffin County Cattle Association.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the House Transportation Committee and serves on the Judiciary, Natural Resources and Energy, and Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection committees.
